summary: Independently checked all nine proposed facts against owned canonical source and contextual ground, debug, accessor and hitbox definitions. Document and proposal agree. Retain inherited supported names and knowledge; no reviewer corrections required.

proposed_facts.reason: The single source table row dispatches the stated callbacks. Animation increments before testing <=24; reciprocal-link failure is immediately terminal. Setup and reflection reset age. This describes callback behavior, not compiled section layout.
Ground state-1 collision refreshes the air component only after its surface and angle checks pass. Animation separately enforces reciprocal linkage and refresh-age expiration.
From zero without resets, the increment-before-test permits 24 continuing callbacks and expires on callback 25. Invalid linkage can trigger cleanup earlier.

Constructor ordering and allocation-failure handling match canonical source. The owner-dependent helper configures collision-display bits rather than registering ownership; subsequent age resets invalidate an absolute lifetime bound.
All five terminal interaction callbacks reset hitboxes and conditionally unlink. Reflection instead rebuilds position and direction, resets age, restarts state 0, and returns false.

GET_ITEM and GET_JOBJ expand to direct GObj dereferences before the explicit guard. Null userdata on a valid GObj skips setup; null GObj is not a safe no-op. Initial and repeated ground callers match the description.

Damage-dealt performs terminal cleanup of the paired component. Ground collision creates it during terrain contact; neither this callback nor its creation establishes a 10-percent descending-shot mapping.
Shield contact resets hitboxes and severs the paired relationship. Terrain-contact construction supports distinguishing the Air kind from aerial firing mode.
The shield callback guards reciprocal cleanup, clears its own link, and returns true. The ground helper only clears its backlink and does not directly destroy the ground object.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all eight section facts and both section links. Source establishes a table declaration, transform operations and scalar arithmetic, but not compiled extents, padding, assertion strings, pool membership or operand placement.

Accept deferral of the extra-coverage-hitbox claim. Bone-derived ground tracking is established, but the ground controller resets hitboxes at initial contact; article, animation and hitbox data are needed to determine coverage beneath the arch.

Accept the lifetime and linkage corrections in facts 0–4: timeout is reset-relative and occurs at incremented age 25, while invalid reciprocal linkage terminates immediately. Reflection and accepted surface updates reset age.
Accept correction of the constructor explanation: post-creation setup configures debug collision display, and the constructor subsequently stores its article-specific owner field.
Accept correction of the null-safety claim: object accessors dereference before the apparent guard.

Accept removal of descending aerial-shot damage and firing-mode attributions. The component is created at terrain contact; damage-dealt and shield-hit callbacks establish cleanup, not firing mode or damage amount.
Accept the shield-purpose correction and full terminal-event explanation: hitbox reset precedes conditional unlinking, and clearing the ground backlink is not direct destruction.
